name: agentic-dev
description: Module 16 (Agentic Dev) — the loop for building product with agents: an orchestrator that acts as product owner, separate contracts for dev, QA, security and release, a deploy gate that decides what ships without a human, a source-weighted live backlog, two-tier verification and simulated-user audits. Ships a stack blueprint with a keyless, self-configuring deploy. An incident in one project becomes a rule in all of them.
